period: 2026年9月19日—10月2日 · 尼泊尔独立版（持续更新）
status: 截至9月25日，本期已核验8条事件；新增 Nepal Telecom 实时计费及客户支持系统国际招标，截止日期和投标保证金已核对官方原件。候选不直接作为新闻，未知投标人与合同金额不作推定。
statusEn: As of 25 September, eight events are reviewed. Added Nepal Telecom's international real-time billing/customer-support tender, with deadlines and bid security checked against the official document. Candidates are not published as facts; bidders and contract value remain unconfirmed.
summary: 9月23日 Nepal Telecom 发布虚拟化平台计费及客户支持系统国际招标：10月8日标前会，10月30日中午交纸质标。投标保证金为90,276,000尼泊尔卢比，不能当作合同预算；未公布本轮投标厂家。
尼泊尔电信在洪灾地区提供免费光纤设备修复、补卡和灾备链路，并于9月22日披露 Bhadra 月在五省11个县投产13个2G/4G站点；两项均未披露新增采购预算或设备供应商。
尼泊尔证券交易所在停市一天后于9月22日恢复交易，72家券商系统从 Butwal 灾备中心恢复；勒索软件成因、影响范围与数据是否外泄仍待正式取证结论。
最高法院驳回 Dish Media Network、Classic Tech、Vianet 和 Subisu 针对电信服务税追缴决定的四份诉状，ISP税务与合规风险显著上升，但完整书面判决及最终应付金额尚未公开核实。
中国气象局向尼泊尔水文与气象部门移交 MAZU-NEPAL 人工智能气象平台，并提出后续部署卫星AI设备、培训和数据共享；目前未披露预算、采购或本地数据治理条款。
本期应重点跟踪 NEPSE/券商生态的正式取证与韧性采购、ISP税案书面判决、NTA规则定稿、尼泊尔电信扩容采购，以及 MAZU 后续设备和数据安排。
summaryEn: Nepal Telecom issued its virtualized billing/customer-support tender on 23 September: pre-bid meeting on 8 October and hard-copy bids due at noon on 30 October. NPR 90,276,000 is bid security, not a contract budget; current bidders are not disclosed.

Nepal Telecom is providing free fibre repair, SIM replacement and recovery connectivity in flood-affected areas, and disclosed on 22 September that 13 2G/4G sites went live across 11 districts in five provinces during Bhadra. Neither development identifies a new procurement budget or equipment supplier.

Nepal Stock Exchange resumed trading on 22 September after a one-day halt, with systems serving 72 brokers restored from the Butwal disaster-recovery site. Ransomware causation, affected scope and possible data exfiltration still await a formal forensic finding.

The Supreme Court dismissed four petitions by Dish Media Network, Classic Tech, Vianet and Subisu against telecom-service-charge collection decisions. ISP tax and compliance risk has risen, but the full written judgment and final payable amount remain unverified.

China Meteorological Administration transferred the MAZU-NEPAL AI weather platform to Nepal's hydrology and meteorology authority and outlined future satellite-AI equipment, training and data-sharing support. No budget, procurement or local data-governance terms have been disclosed.

Priority follow-up covers the formal NEPSE/broker forensic review and resilience procurement, the ISP tax judgment, final NTA infrastructure rules, Nepal Telecom expansion procurement, and MAZU equipment and data arrangements.

items.title: 尼泊尔电信重启实时计费与客户支持系统国际招标，10月30日截标
items.titleEn: Nepal Telecom launches billing and customer-support tender, with bids due 30 October
items.text: 事实：Nepal Telecom 官方采购门户及9月23日招标文件确认，标号 NDCL/CTO/ICB/02/083-84，采购虚拟化平台上的融合实时计费与客户支持系统，覆盖供货、安装、测试、投运和支持。采用国际竞争、单阶段双信封、纸质投标。官方文件第5—6页列明：标前会10月8日11:30；投标截止10月30日12:00，13:00开标（加德满都当地时间）；文件费100,000尼泊尔卢比，最低投标保证金90,276,000卢比，或588,000美元、512,000欧元。保证金不是合同金额。部分媒体对尼历截止日的转述不一致，本条以官方公历日期为准，仍需跟踪后续澄清及延期。尚无本轮投标名单或授标依据。行业媒体称存量系统来自 AsiaInfo；这是现网背景，不代表亚信、华为、浩鲸或其他厂家已参加或获本轮订单。
items.textEn: Fact: Nepal Telecom's procurement portal and bidding document issued on 23 September confirm IFB NDCL/CTO/ICB/02/083-84 for a virtualized convergent real-time billing and customer-support system, including supply, installation, testing, commissioning and support. It uses international competition, a single-stage two-envelope procedure and hard-copy bids. PDF pages 5–6 specify a pre-bid meeting on 8 October at 11:30, submission by 30 October at 12:00 and opening at 13:00 (Kathmandu local time); document fee NPR 100,000; minimum bid security NPR 90,276,000, alternatively USD 588,000 or EUR 512,000. Security is not contract value. A media rendering of the Nepali deadline is inconsistent; this item uses official Gregorian dates, subject to later clarifications or extensions. No current bidder list or award is established. Industry media identify AsiaInfo as the incumbent system supplier; that background does not prove participation or an award for AsiaInfo, Huawei, Whale Cloud or any other vendor in this round.
items.opportunity: 客户与阶段：Nepal Telecom 的 CTO 采购部门及 IT 团队，已进入正式招标而非一般数字化意向。下一步：先获取完整正式标书并确认资格，再梳理存量数据迁移、计费准确性、接口兼容、容灾切换和长期支持的证明材料；在标前会上澄清验收与回退责任。竞争研判：存量维护经验不等于新标资格，旧轮投标及淘汰情况不能移用到本轮。未知项：实际参标企业、合同总价和中标厂家。
items.opportunityEn: Customer and stage: Nepal Telecom's CTO procurement department and IT team, at formal tender stage rather than a general digitalisation intention. Next action: obtain the complete official documents and confirm eligibility, then prepare evidence for legacy-data migration, billing accuracy, interface compatibility, recovery and long-term support; clarify acceptance and rollback responsibilities at the pre-bid meeting. Competition: incumbent maintenance experience does not establish eligibility, and previous-round bidder outcomes cannot be carried into this round. Unknowns: actual participants, total contract value and awarded supplier.
items.badge: 官方采购门户及招标文件核验 · Tier 1

items.title: 尼泊尔电信扩大洪灾通信保障：免费修复光纤、补卡并打通灾备链路
items.titleEn: Nepal Telecom expands flood communications support and disaster-recovery links
items.text: 事实：Radio Nepal、eKantipur 和 Technology Khabar 均引述 Nepal Telecom 9月21日公告称，公司正为 Rasuwa、Dhading、Gorkha、Chitwan、Nuwakot、Tanahun 等受灾地区及相关道路走廊提供额外通信保障。措施包括免费更换或安装损坏的 NT Fiber 线缆和路由器、对已到期服务免费延长3个月、按最近五个呼叫号码核验后补发 SIM 并更新 KYC，以及配合尼泊尔军方向救援行动提供210张含套餐的 SIM。公司还为国家减灾与风险管理局主备服务器提供免费暗光纤物理连接，并向部分救援中心和地方行政机构提供高速互联网。报道所称约2亿尼泊尔卢比为公司过往多类救灾援助总额，不是本次网络设备采购预算。
items.textEn: Radio Nepal, eKantipur and Technology Khabar cite Nepal Telecom's 21 September notice on additional communications support across flood-affected areas including Rasuwa, Dhading, Gorkha, Chitwan, Nuwakot and Tanahun and associated road corridors. Measures include free replacement or installation of damaged NT Fiber cable and routers, a three-month extension for expired services, SIM reissue after last-five-number verification and KYC update, and 210 packaged SIMs supplied with the Nepal Army for rescue communications. Nepal Telecom is also providing free dark-fibre physical connectivity between the disaster authority's primary and backup servers and high-speed internet at selected relief and administration sites. The reported roughly NPR 200 million is cumulative aid across previous relief categories, not a budget for this equipment programme.
items.opportunity: 客户与需求：Nepal Telecom、NDRRMA、地方行政机构和灾区用户需要恢复接入、主备连接及应急通信；当前阶段是已执行的救灾与业务恢复，不是公开采购。竞争研判：报道没有披露设备厂商、系统集成商、招标、合同或中标结果，不能据此认定任何厂商参与。下一步：跟踪 Nepal Telecom、NDRRMA、PPMO 和地方政府是否发布灾后网络重建、数据中心互联、备件或运维采购，并核查后续资金来自运营商自有资金、普遍服务基金还是救灾拨款。证据缺口：新增预算、技术规格、采购主体、交付期限、光纤路径和供应商均未知。
items.opportunityEn: Customers and need: Nepal Telecom, NDRRMA, local administrations and affected users need access restoration, primary-backup connectivity and emergency communications. The present stage is executed relief and service restoration, not a public procurement. Competition: no equipment vendor, integrator, tender, contract or award is disclosed, so supplier participation cannot be inferred. Next action: monitor Nepal Telecom, NDRRMA, PPMO and local authorities for post-disaster network reconstruction, data-centre interconnect, spares or managed-service procurement, and verify whether subsequent funding comes from the operator, the universal-service fund or disaster allocations. Gaps: new budget, technical specification, procuring entity, delivery timetable, fibre routes and supplier remain unknown.
items.badge: 公共广播 + 主流媒体交叉核验 · Tier 1/2

items.title: 尼泊尔电信在五省11个县投产13个2G/4G站点
items.titleEn: Nepal Telecom activates 13 2G/4G sites across 11 districts in five provinces
items.text: 事实：NepaliTelecom、Technology Khabar 和 Naya Patrika 9月22日报道，Nepal Telecom 在 Bhadra 2083 月期间投产13个同时提供2G与4G服务的移动站点，覆盖 Bagmati、Gandaki、Lumbini、Karnali 和 Sudurpashchim 五省的11个县。报道列出的地点包括 Lalitpur、Chitwan、Nawalpur、Lamjung、Kapilvastu、Palpa、Jumla、Surkhet、Bajura、Dadeldhura 和 Darchula 的偏远或服务不足区域。公司发言人 Dr Kamal Lamichhane 表示，新站点用于改善语音和高速移动数据覆盖。报道未披露无线设备供应商、传输方案、频段增配、资本开支、招标或合同。
items.textEn: NepaliTelecom, Technology Khabar and Naya Patrika reported on 22 September that Nepal Telecom activated 13 mobile sites providing both 2G and 4G service during Bhadra 2083. The sites span 11 districts across Bagmati, Gandaki, Lumbini, Karnali and Sudurpashchim provinces, including underserved or remote locations in Lalitpur, Chitwan, Nawalpur, Lamjung, Kapilvastu, Palpa, Jumla, Surkhet, Bajura, Dadeldhura and Darchula. Spokesperson Dr Kamal Lamichhane said the sites are intended to improve voice and high-speed mobile-data coverage. Reporting identifies no radio supplier, transmission design, additional spectrum, capital expenditure, tender or contract.
items.opportunity: 客户与需求：Nepal Telecom 持续补齐偏远地区覆盖，后续可能涉及站点供电、传输、优化、备件和运维，但本次只是已投产网络的运营披露。竞争研判：没有供应商、设备型号、建设批次或授标信息，不能把13站点归因于任何设备商，也不能据此新增销售管道。下一步：核查 Nepal Telecom 官方新闻稿、年度资本预算、PPMO/公司采购公告及 NTA 频谱和覆盖资料，确认这些站点属于既有合同、存量设备搬迁还是新增采购。证据缺口：供应商、BTS/eNodeB配置、回传、功率与灾备、验收日期、预算和覆盖KPI均未知。
items.opportunityEn: Customer and need: Nepal Telecom continues to close coverage gaps in remote areas, which may create follow-on needs for site power, transmission, optimisation, spares and operations, but this disclosure concerns already activated network. Competition: no supplier, equipment model, deployment lot or award is identified, so the 13 sites cannot be attributed to any vendor or entered as a new sales pipeline. Next action: verify the Nepal Telecom release, annual capex, company/PPMO procurement notices and NTA spectrum and coverage records to establish whether the sites draw on an existing contract, redeployed assets or new procurement. Gaps: supplier, BTS/eNodeB configuration, backhaul, power and resilience, acceptance dates, budget and coverage KPIs are unknown.
items.badge: 三家行业/主流媒体交叉核验 · Tier 2

items.title: 通信基础设施规则修订仍在讨论，尚未形成有效的新许可框架
items.titleEn: Telecom infrastructure-rule revision remains under discussion
items.text: 事实：Technology Khabar 9月21日报道，通信部长 Dr Bikram Timilsina 此前要求尼泊尔电信管理局（NTA）在两天内提交新的通信基础设施规则，但约两个月后仍未完成。NTA 发言人 Min Prasad Aryal 对该媒体表示文本仍在讨论，完成后才会上报。该报道提及草案或涉及大型基础设施、小型基础设施和骨干光纤公司的分类许可，但草案不是生效规则；其关于 NTA 董事会因错误退回文本的说法来自未具名消息源，尚无独立官方确认。NTA 官方法规页目前仍列示《Telecommunications Infrastructure Regulations 2074》，未见新规则正式发布。
items.textEn: Technology Khabar reported on 21 September that a replacement telecom-infrastructure regulation remained unfinished roughly two months after Communications Minister Dr Bikram Timilsina instructed Nepal Telecommunications Authority to submit it within two days. NTA spokesperson Min Prasad Aryal told the outlet that the text was still under discussion and would be forwarded when complete. The report says the draft may contemplate separate licensing for large infrastructure, small infrastructure and backbone fibre companies, but the draft is not an effective rule. Its claim that the NTA board returned the text for errors relies on an unnamed source and lacks independent official confirmation. NTA's official regulation page still lists Telecommunications Infrastructure Regulations 2074 and does not show a newly enacted replacement.
items.opportunity: 客户与影响：运营商、独立基础设施公司和骨干光纤投资方可能受未来许可分类及基础设施共享规则影响；当前仍是政策起草阶段。竞争研判：没有生效条文、许可申请、招标、预算或获批公司，不能据媒体描述建立市场份额或项目判断。下一步：持续核查 NTA 董事会会议记录、NTA与MoCIT通知、Nepal Gazette、公开咨询文件及实施日期，并向官方确认媒体所称“退回草案”。证据缺口：最终许可类别、数量、资本要求、共享义务、过渡安排和审批时间均未知。
items.opportunityEn: Customers and impact: operators, independent infrastructure companies and backbone-fibre investors may be affected by future licence categories and sharing rules; the process remains at policy-drafting stage. Competition: there is no effective text, licence application, tender, budget or approved company, so the media description cannot support market-share or project conclusions. Next action: monitor NTA board minutes, NTA and MoCIT notices, the Nepal Gazette, consultation documents and the effective date, and seek official confirmation of the media claim that the draft was returned. Gaps: final licence classes, number of licences, capital requirements, sharing obligations, transition rules and approval timing are unknown.
items.badge: 媒体报道 + NTA官网核验 · Tier 1/2

items.title: 通信部长提出“韧性数字化”五项优先方向，灾害期间服务连续性进入政策核心
items.titleEn: Communications minister sets five priorities for resilient digital transformation
items.text: 事实：尼泊尔公共广播 Radio Nepal、Digital Nepal Conclave 官方议程及 Technology Khabar 显示，通信部长 Dr Bikram Timilsina 于9月20日在拉利特普尔举行的 Digital Nepal Conclave 2026 上表示，数字化不仅是技术扩展和政务现代化，还应在灾害与危机中维持信息、通信及公共服务。他提出五项优先方向：信息可信与公众信任、可靠且包容的连接、政府机构互操作、以公民为中心的数字服务，以及负责任的人工智能与数据治理。此次讲话是政策方向，不是已批准的预算、建设项目、招标或设备授标。
items.textEn: Radio Nepal, the official Digital Nepal Conclave programme and Technology Khabar report that Communications Minister Dr Bikram Timilsina told the 20 September event in Lalitpur that digital transformation must extend beyond technology expansion and service modernisation to maintain information, communications and public services during disasters and crises. He identified five priorities: information integrity and public trust, reliable and inclusive connectivity, interoperability among government bodies, citizen-centred digital services, and responsible AI and data governance. The speech sets policy direction; it is not an approved budget, deployment project, tender or equipment award.
items.opportunity: 客户影响：相关政府机构未来可能把业务连续性、互操作、安全和灾备要求纳入数字战略，但讲话没有确认实施主体、预算或采购范围，因此目前不是可直接计入销售管道的商机。竞争研判：会议信息列出支持方和展示企业，不能据此认定任何公司已获项目、成为投标方或形成设备选型。下一步：跟踪 MoCIT 及相关机构的实施方案、Digital Nepal Framework预算科目、工作组与KPI、PPMO采购公告、政府架构与数据治理标准，以及会后正式记录；只有出现明确责任单位、资金或采购文件后再建立客户机会。证据缺口：时间表、预算、技术架构、采购路径、供应商、合同及历史执行记录均未披露。
items.opportunityEn: Customer impact: relevant government bodies may incorporate continuity, interoperability, security and recovery requirements into future digital strategies, but the speech confirms no implementation owner, budget or procurement scope. It is therefore not a directly actionable sales opportunity. Competition: the event lists supporters and exhibitors; participation does not establish an award, bidder status or equipment selection. Next action: monitor MoCIT and relevant agencies for implementation plans, Digital Nepal Framework budget lines, working groups and KPIs, PPMO procurement notices, government architecture and data-governance standards, and formal post-event records. Create a customer opportunity only after a responsible agency, funding or procurement document is identified. Gaps: no timetable, budget, architecture, procurement path, supplier, contract or implementation history was disclosed.
items.badge: 官方议程 + 公共广播核验 · Tier 1/2

items.title: 最高法院驳回四家ISP电信服务税诉状，追缴与罚款风险上升
items.titleEn: Supreme Court dismisses four ISP petitions over telecom service charges
items.text: 事实：Technology Khabar 和 Nagarik Times 9月22日报道，最高法院 Abdul Aziz Musalman 与 Nripadhwaj Niraula 两位法官组成的合议庭，驳回 Dish Media Network、Classic Tech、Vianet Communications 和 Subisu 提交的四份诉状。这些公司分别挑战大额纳税人办公室和税务部门要求缴纳电信服务税（TSC）的决定。Technology Khabar 同时称，法院在 Bhesh Raj Luitel 针对 WorldLink 相关不起诉决定提出的关联诉状中发布了命令。媒体对潜在追缴金额的报道不一致，完整书面判决、逐家公司税额、罚款及适用期间尚未从法院原文核实，因此本简报不采用金额估算。
items.textEn: Technology Khabar and Nagarik Times reported on 22 September that a Supreme Court division bench of Justices Abdul Aziz Musalman and Nripadhwaj Niraula dismissed four petitions filed by Dish Media Network, Classic Tech, Vianet Communications and Subisu. The companies had separately challenged decisions by the Large Taxpayers Office and tax authorities requiring payment of telecom service charges. Technology Khabar also reported that the court issued an order in a related petition by Bhesh Raj Luitel concerning an earlier decision not to prosecute a WorldLink matter. Media estimates of the potential collection differ, and the full written judgment, company-level assessments, penalties and covered tax periods have not been verified from the court text, so this briefing does not adopt an amount estimate.
items.opportunity: 合规影响：四家主要宽带/融合服务商面临更高的历史税款、罚款、现金流和财务披露风险，WorldLink关联案件也需单独核实；这可能影响网络投资节奏、资费、融资和供应商付款，但目前不能量化。竞争研判：裁定不是ICT采购或设备授标，也不能据此判断任何运营商信用事件已经发生。下一步：取得最高法院完整判决和案号，逐一核对税务机关通知、涉及年度、应纳税基数及执行/上诉路径，并跟踪公司公告、NTA与税务部门后续安排。证据缺口：最终应付金额、会计拨备、执行期限、复审可能性及对资本开支的实际影响均未知。
items.opportunityEn: Compliance impact: four major broadband/converged-service providers face higher exposure to historical tax, penalties, cash flow and financial-disclosure risk, while the related WorldLink matter requires separate verification. This could affect network investment timing, tariffs, financing and supplier payments, but cannot yet be quantified. Competition: the ruling is not an ICT procurement or equipment award and does not establish that any operator credit event has occurred. Next action: obtain the full Supreme Court judgments and case numbers, verify each tax notice, covered periods, taxable base and enforcement/appeal path, and monitor company disclosures and follow-up by NTA and tax authorities. Gaps: final payable amount, accounting provisions, enforcement deadline, review options and actual capex impact remain unknown.
items.badge: 两家媒体交叉核验，待法院全文 · Tier 2

items.title: 尼泊尔股市停摆一天后恢复，72家券商系统从灾备中心重启
items.titleEn: Nepal trading resumes after one-day halt as systems for 72 brokers recover from DR site
items.text: 事实：Nepal Stock Exchange（NEPSE）依据交易规则21(1)于9月21日暂停常规交易，原因是托管72家券商服务器的 DataHub Pvt Ltd 数据中心自9月20日上午出现问题。NEPSE 9月22日确认技术问题已解决并恢复常规交易；OnlineKhabar 后续报道称，受影响系统使用 DataHub 位于 Butwal 的灾备中心数据恢复。Kathmandu Post 和 OnlineKhabar 报道，YCO/DataHub 向相关方说明事件涉及勒索软件，并称交易管理系统、CDSC相关系统、支付网关及其他互联服务受到影响。NEPSE 对外公告仍采用“技术问题”表述，因此攻击入口、数据完整性及是否外泄仍须等待正式取证结论。
items.textEn: Nepal Stock Exchange suspended regular trading on 21 September under Rule 21(1) after a problem beginning on the morning of 20 September at DataHub Pvt Ltd, which hosts servers for 72 brokers. NEPSE confirmed on 22 September that the technical problem had been resolved and regular trading resumed; OnlineKhabar subsequently reported that affected systems were restored using data from DataHub's disaster-recovery centre in Butwal. Kathmandu Post and OnlineKhabar report that YCO/DataHub described the incident to stakeholders as ransomware affecting the trading management system, CDSC-related systems, payment gateways and other interconnected services. NEPSE's public notice still uses the term 'technical problem', so the entry vector, data integrity and possible exfiltration require a formal forensic finding.
items.opportunity: 客户与需求：NEPSE、券商、DataHub/YCO及证券市场基础设施需要可验证的多站点灾备、不可变备份、网络与身份隔离、安全监测、事件响应和定期演练。系统恢复证明灾备发挥作用，但停市一天也暴露72家券商集中托管与故障域风险；当前仍是恢复与调查，不是公开采购。竞争研判：报道没有披露未来采购主体、预算、招标、技术路线、入围厂商或合同；DataHub 是数据中心、YCO 是交易系统服务商，均不能据此当作设备OEM或中标方。下一步：跟踪 NEPSE、SEBON、CDSC、券商协会及 PPMO 的取证报告、数据完整性验证、补救要求和采购公告，并确认是否形成统一行业韧性标准。证据缺口：攻击入口、数据影响、RPO/RTO、现有架构、预算和采购日程均未知。
items.opportunityEn: Customers and need: NEPSE, brokers, DataHub/YCO and securities-market infrastructure require tested multi-site recovery, immutable backup, network and identity isolation, security monitoring, incident response and regular exercises. Restoration shows that the recovery site functioned, while the one-day halt exposes concentration and shared-failure-domain risk across 72 brokers. The current stage remains recovery and investigation, not a public procurement. Competition: reporting identifies no future buyer, budget, tender, architecture, shortlisted supplier or contract; DataHub is a data centre and YCO a trading-system service provider, so neither can be treated as an equipment OEM or awardee. Next action: follow NEPSE, SEBON, CDSC, the brokers' association and PPMO for forensic reports, data-integrity verification, remediation requirements and procurement notices, and verify whether a common sector-resilience standard emerges. Gaps: entry vector, data impact, RPO/RTO, current architecture, budget and procurement timing are unknown.

items.title: 中国向尼泊尔移交 MAZU 人工智能气象平台，后续拟部署卫星AI设备
items.titleEn: China transfers MAZU AI weather platform to Nepal and outlines satellite-AI follow-on
items.text: 事实：Annapurna Express、Technology Khabar、Bizmandu 和 Baahrakhari 9月22日报道，中国气象局在乌鲁木齐举行的第二届中国—中亚气象合作论坛期间，将 MAZU-NEPAL 人工智能气象平台正式移交尼泊尔水文与气象部门。平台自8月29日起开展云端试运行，整合风云气象卫星观测与“风清”“风顺”等中国AI预报模型，为尼泊尔提供高分辨率快速监测和预警；报道还称双方计划在尼泊尔部署 MAZU-风云卫星AI Box及集成设备，并建立技术培训、数据共享和联合会商机制。现有报道未披露采购合同、预算、软硬件清单、本地部署位置或数据治理条款。
items.textEn: Annapurna Express, Technology Khabar, Bizmandu and Baahrakhari reported on 22 September that China Meteorological Administration formally transferred the MAZU-NEPAL AI meteorological platform to Nepal's hydrology and meteorology authority during the second China-Central Asia Meteorological Cooperation Forum in Urumqi. Cloud trial operation began on 29 August. The platform integrates FengYun satellite observations with Chinese AI forecasting models including Fengqing and Fengshun to provide high-resolution rapid monitoring and warnings customised for Nepal. Reporting also says the parties plan to deploy a MAZU-FengYun Satellite AI Box and integrated equipment in Nepal and establish technical training, data sharing and joint consultation mechanisms. No procurement contract, budget, bill of materials, local hosting site or data-governance terms have been disclosed.
items.opportunity: 客户与需求：尼泊尔水文与气象部门、灾害管理机构及地方预警体系可能需要卫星数据接入、边缘AI设备、算力与存储、网络连接、集成、培训和长期运维。当前阶段是政府间技术移交和后续合作意向，不是公开招标或商业授标。竞争研判：平台和计划中的AI Box来自中国气象局体系，不能推定华为、运营商或本地集成商已参与，也不能把未来设备计划视为已签合同。下一步：核查中国气象局和尼泊尔官方移交文件、DHM/NDRRMA实施计划、设备部署时间、数据跨境与主权要求、运维责任、资金来源及任何 PPMO 采购。证据缺口：预算、采购方式、设备配置、接口、本地托管、安全基线、供应商和服务期限均未知。
items.opportunityEn: Customers and need: Nepal's hydrology and meteorology authority, disaster-management agencies and local warning systems may require satellite-data access, edge-AI equipment, compute and storage, connectivity, integration, training and long-term operations. The present stage is an intergovernmental technology transfer and follow-on cooperation intent, not an open tender or commercial award. Competition: the platform and planned AI Box come through the China Meteorological Administration system; this does not establish participation by Huawei, an operator or a local integrator, nor does the future equipment plan constitute a signed contract. Next action: obtain CMA and Nepal government transfer records, DHM/NDRRMA implementation plans, deployment timing, cross-border and sovereign-data requirements, operations ownership, funding source and any PPMO procurement. Gaps: budget, procurement method, equipment configuration, interfaces, local hosting, security baseline, supplier and service term remain unknown.
